name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.252.0 — Two prototype fixes from the queue groom: --mark closed deletes the overlay files the driver itself copied into the worktree (when still untracked) before removing it, so closing no longer refuses on every real host; a bare re-run with the same words after opening under --stem resumes that prototype instead of opening a second one. 7.251.0 — Queue hygiene: add refuses near-duplicate prompts (Jaccard >= 0.35, --distinct overrides); list shows an age column and cites-done / gate-met / stale flags; ticked and done rows archive to spec-queue-done.json on every write; new read-only groom subcommand. 7.250.0 — Review closes its own soft findings: the CLOSE step prints a soft sweep, --mark soft-swept --file records each soft as fixed or advisory debt in the spec's Rationale, --mark closed refuses an unswept soft or a sweep fix over a 60-line ceiling, the close row carries softSweep; DISPOSITIONS and stage doctrine no longer queue softs.
